title: ARISE: Adapting to Evolving Capability Gaps in Agentic Reinforcement Learning

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly act as agents that reason, invoke tools, and interact with environments to complete multi-step tasks ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ; Feng et al., 2026 ) . These long-horizon tasks require the coordination of capabilities such as planning, execution, and verification ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) . Reinforcement learning refines these behaviors through interactive experience ( Ivison et al., 2026 ) . Although recent methods enrich this process with behavioral feedback and reusable guidance ( Chen et al., 2026b ; Shao et al., 2026 ; Xia et al., 2026 ) , structuring training for sustained capability development remains an open question.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地扮演智能体的角色，通过推理、调用工具以及与环境交互来完成多步骤任务（Yao 等，2023；Yang 等，2024；Feng 等，2026）。 这些长期任务需要规划、执行和验证等能力的协同配合（Yao 等，2023；Shinn 等，2023）。 强化学习通过互动经验来优化这些行为（Ivison 等，2026）。 尽管近期方法通过行为反馈和可重复使用的指导丰富了这一过程（Chen 等，2026b；Shao 等，2026；Xia 等，2026），但如何构建训练以持续促进能力发展仍然是一个开放问题。

paragraphs.en: Two coupled challenges hinder aligning training with evolving agent capabilities: (i) Tracking evolving capability gaps. Correcting an intermediate error may leave the task reward unchanged if subsequent steps prevent completion, masking shifts in behavioral bottlenecks ( Lightman et al., 2024 ) . Furthermore, even detailed criteria become uninformative once consistently satisfied, while out-of-scope bottlenecks remain unmeasured. (ii) Exploring beyond repeated failures. While precise evaluation distinguishes sampled behaviors, it cannot guarantee the generation of useful alternatives. Under group-relative optimization, identical task rewards within a rollout group yield zero advantage, even if trajectories differ in intermediate steps ( Shao et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) . Consequently, mastered or excessively difficult tasks waste rollout budgets without providing useful reward contrasts, making their learning value highly dependent on the policy’s developmental stage ( Florensa et al., 2018 ) . Together, these challenges necessitate training paradigms that continually identify areas for improvement and foster the exploration and reinforcement of corresponding behaviors.
paragraphs.zh: 有两个相互关联的挑战阻碍了训练与不断发展的智能体能力之间的对齐：(i) 追踪不断变化的能力差距。 如果后续步骤导致任务无法完成，纠正中间错误可能不会改变任务奖励，从而掩盖行为瓶颈的变化（Lightman 等，2024）。 此外，一旦详细的标准被持续满足，这些标准就会变得无信息价值，而超出范围的瓶颈则仍然无法衡量。 (ii) 探索重复失败之外的可能性。 虽然精确评估能够区分采样出的行为，但它无法保证生成有用的替代方案。 在群体相对优化中，同一展开组内的相同任务奖励会导致优势为零，即使轨迹在中间步骤中存在差异（Shao 等，2024；Yu 等，2025）。 因此，已掌握或过于困难的任务会浪费展开预算，而无法提供有用的奖励对比，这使得它们的学习价值高度依赖于策略的发展阶段（Florensa 等，2018）。 综合来看，这些挑战要求训练范式能够持续识别改进领域，并促进相应行为的探索与强化。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we propose A daptive R ubr i c– S kill Co- E volution ( Arise ), a reinforcement learning framework driven by evolving capability gaps (Figure 1 (b)). It translates rollout evidence of these gaps into concrete behavioral requirements, each formalized as a rubric for evaluating partial progress and a paired skill for guiding action. Rubric pass rates then direct exploration: low rates trigger skill activation or refinement, whereas consistently high rates indicate mastery, allowing the criterion to be retired. As new evidence emerges, the framework expands this repertoire to cover unaddressed behaviors, ensuring the requirements remain responsive to policy development.
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出了自适应评分标准–技能协同演化（Arise）框架，这是一个由不断变化的能力差距驱动的强化学习框架（图 1(b)）。 该框架将这些能力差距的演练证据转化为具体的行为要求，每个要求都被形式化为一个用于评估部分进展的评分标准，以及一个用于指导行动的配套技能。 随后，评分标准的通过率将引导探索过程：较低的通过率会触发技能的激活或优化，而持续较高的通过率则表明已掌握该技能，此时可淘汰该标准。 随着新证据的出现，该框架会扩展这一技能库以覆盖尚未解决的行为，从而确保这些要求能够持续响应策略的发展。

paragraphs.en: Progress on these requirements also depends on task context, as a behavior performed reliably in one task type may remain difficult in another. We therefore propose a capability-based adaptive sampler that guides task selection using rubric-based estimates of capability performance within each task type. Subsequent rollouts provide feedback for updating rubrics, paired skills, and the sampling distribution, ensuring that evolving capability assessments shape future training. As shown in Figure 1 (a), Arise significantly improves SkillsBench performance over its base model, achieving competitive results with much larger models.
paragraphs.zh: 这些需求的进展也取决于任务上下文，因为某种行为在一类任务中能够可靠执行，但在另一类任务中可能仍然困难。 因此，我们提出一种基于能力的自适应采样器，该采样器利用基于评分标准的各任务类型中的能力表现估计值来指导任务选择。 后续的部署过程会提供反馈以更新评分标准、配套技能以及采样分布，从而确保不断发展的能力评估能够影响未来的训练。 如图 1 (a) 所示，Arise 相较于其基础模型显著提升了 SkillsBench 的表现，并实现了与规模大得多的模型相媲美的结果。

paragraphs.en: In summary, our contributions are three-fold:
paragraphs.zh: 总而言之，我们的贡献有三方面：

paragraphs.en: We identify evolving capability gaps as a central challenge in long-horizon agent learning. Instead of relying on static behavioral requirements or training priorities, Arise continuously leverages rollout evidence to dynamically uncover and address emerging bottlenecks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将不断演化的能力差距视为长期智能体学习中的核心挑战。 Arise 不依赖静态的行为要求或训练优先级，而是持续利用部署证据，动态地发现并解决新出现的瓶颈。

paragraphs.en: Empirically, we demonstrate that adapting training to these evolving capabilities yields substantial and efficient performance gains. Across two agent benchmarks, Arise consistently outperforms same-scale baselines, proving to be a highly effective alternative to simply scaling model size.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过实证表明，根据这些不断发展的能力调整训练方法，能够带来显著且高效的性能提升。 在两项智能体基准测试中，Arise 始终优于同规模的基础模型，证明其是单纯扩大模型规模的极具成效的替代方案。

paragraphs.en: Rubric-based approaches deconstruct evaluation into explicit criteria, aggregating individual judgments to derive training rewards ( Gunjal et al., 2026 ; Viswanathan et al., 2025 ) . To make these evaluations adaptive, frameworks like OnlineRubrics ( Rezaei et al., 2026 ) extract criteria by comparing current and reference outputs, while DR Tulu ( Shao et al., 2026 ) continuously updates rubrics based on on-policy responses and search contexts. However, these response-level evaluations often overlook improvements in intermediate actions that are not reflected in the final output. RuscaRL ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) further uses rubrics as both rewards and exploration scaffolds, yet relies on fixed underlying criteria and decays guidance according to a predefined schedule. In contrast, Arise evaluates intermediate agent behaviors and dynamically revises active criteria as rollout evidence reveals new or consistently mastered behavioral requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 基于评分标准的方法将评估分解为明确的评判维度，通过汇总个体判断来推导出训练奖励（Gunjal 等，2026；Viswanathan 等，2025）。 为了使这些评估具备适应性，像 OnlineRubrics（Rezaei 等，2026）这样的框架通过比较当前输出与参考输出来提取评判维度，而 DR Tulu（Shao 等，2026）则根据策略内响应和搜索上下文持续更新评分标准。 然而，这些基于响应的评估常常忽视了中间动作中的改进，而这些改进并未体现在最终输出中。 RuscaRL（Zhou 等，2026）进一步将评分标准同时用作奖励和探索框架，但仍依赖固定的底层评判维度，并依据预定义的时间表逐渐减弱引导作用。 相比之下，Arise 会评估智能体的中间行为，并根据展开过程中的证据揭示出新的或持续掌握的行为要求，动态调整当前活跃的评判维度。

paragraphs.en: Skill learning enables LLM-based agents to reuse experience through executable routines or natural-language guidance ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Cai et al., 2024 ) . Voyager ( Wang et al., 2024 ) builds a library of executable skills via environment interaction, while ExpeL ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) distills transferable insights. By keeping policy parameters frozen, both methods rely entirely on the in-context capabilities of the base model to leverage this accumulated knowledge. SkillRL ( Xia et al., 2026 ) extends experience reuse to reinforcement learning through a hierarchical skill library, evolving it based on validation success rates. It consistently includes general skills while retrieving task-specific ones via semantic relevance. However, relevance alone does not necessitate guidance, as a retrieved skill may describe behaviors the policy has already mastered. In Arise , evaluations of paired behavioral criteria determine exactly when guidance is needed, providing actionable evidence to refine skills if specific weaknesses persist.

sents.zh: 在 Arise 中，对成对行为标准的评估能够精确判断何时需要指导，从而提供可操作的证据来改进那些仍存在特定弱点的技能。

paragraphs.en: Adaptive task sampling allocates training experience according to the evolving learning needs of the policy ( Jiang et al., 2021 ) . GoalGAN ( Florensa et al., 2018 ) selects goals of intermediate difficulty based on empirical success rates. In reinforcement learning for LLMs, DAPO ( Yu et al., 2025 ) filters groups post-rollout to exclude those lacking reward variation, while VADE ( Hu et al., 2026 ) selects informative samples pre-rollout using online correctness estimates. However, these outcome-based signals capture overall task difficulty without distinguishing the underlying behavioral causes: tasks with similar success rates may require improvements in entirely different capabilities. The distinction in Arise lies in the evidence used for selection: rubric evaluations expose which behaviors remain weak within each task type, rather than only whether tasks succeed.
paragraphs.zh: 自适应任务采样根据策略不断变化的学习需求分配训练经验（Jiang 等人，2021）。 GoalGAN（Florensa 等人，2018）基于经验成功率选择中等难度的目标。 在大型语言模型的强化学习中，DAPO（Yu 等人，2025）在推理后筛选任务组，排除缺乏奖励变化的任务；而 VADE（Hu 等人，2026）则通过在线正确率估计在推理前选择信息丰富的样本。 然而，这些基于结果的信号仅能反映整体任务难度，而无法区分其背后的行为原因：成功率相似的任务可能需要完全不同的能力改进。 Arise 的不同之处在于其选择依据：评分标准评估能够揭示各类任务中哪些行为仍然薄弱，而不仅仅是任务是否成功。

paragraphs.en: Ablation Study. Dynamic rubric evolution, skill-guided exploration, and capability-based sampling each contribute to the performance of Arise . We evaluate five variants with matched initialization, data, and training budgets: (i) Frozen Rubrics : fixes the pool to include all rubrics from Arise ’s entire training lifecycle; (ii) w/o Skill Injection : removes skill guidance from the policy context; (iii) w/o Adaptive Sampling : disables our adaptive sampler; (iv) w/ VADE Sampling : replaces our sampler with the outcome-based VADE approach ( Hu et al., 2026 ) ; (v) Outcome-only RL : removes rubric rewards, skill injection, and adaptive sampling. As shown in Figure 3 (a), Arise outperforms all variants. Notably, even access to the full lifecycle rubric pool cannot replace dynamic updates, and removing skill guidance degrades performance despite retaining rubric rewards. Furthermore, while VADE sampling improves upon non-adaptive sampling, it falls short of our capability-based approach, confirming the value of behavioral evidence beyond mere task outcomes.
paragraphs.zh: 消融研究。 动态评分标准演化、技能引导探索和能力导向采样各自对 Arise 的性能有所贡献。 我们评估了五个在初始化、数据和训练预算上保持一致的变体：(i) 固定评分标准：将评分标准池固定为包含 Arise 整个训练生命周期中的所有评分标准；(ii) 无技能注入：从策略上下文中移除技能引导；(iii) 无自适应采样：禁用我们的自适应采样器；(iv) 使用 VADE 采样：用基于结果的 VADE 方法（Hu et al., 2026）替代我们的采样器；(v) 仅基于结果的强化学习：移除评分标准奖励、技能注入和自适应采样。 如图 3 (a) 所示，Arise 的性能优于所有变体。 值得注意的是，即使能够访问整个生命周期的评分标准池，也无法替代动态更新；而移除技能引导会导致性能下降，即便保留了评分标准奖励。 此外，尽管 VADE 采样比非自适应采样有所改进，但其表现仍不及我们的能力导向方法，这证实了行为证据相较于单纯的任务结果更具价值。

paragraphs.en: Behavioral Feedback and Exploration. Arise continually refreshes its behavioral criteria and exhibits fewer all-failure rollout groups than training without skill injection. Starting from an empty pool, rubric evolution introduces 36 criteria and retires 21 during training, leaving 15 active (Figure 4 (a)). This turnover demonstrates that supervision evolves through dynamic replacement rather than mere accumulation. Figure 4 (b) shows an early rise in mean rubric reward followed by fluctuations under the changing rubric pool, alongside an overall increase in verifier-based task pass rates. Notably, behavioral pass rates remain high after rubric retirement, even without skill guidance (Appendix G ). To evaluate exploration, we compare Arise against the no-skill variant on a fixed task set. Arise consistently yields lower all-failure rollout rates across all training stages, with the most pronounced gap appearing early on (Figure 4 (c)). Together with the skill-injection ablation, this confirms that skill guidance crucially helps the policy discover successful trajectories. Appendix F provides concrete examples of individual rubric–skill lifecycles.
paragraphs.zh: 行为反馈与探索。 Arise 持续更新其行为标准，且其全失败展开组数量少于无技能注入的训练。 从空池开始，评分标准演化在训练期间引入了 36 项标准并淘汰了 21 项，最终保留 15 项有效标准（图 4 (a)）。 这种更替表明，监督机制是通过动态替换而非简单累积来实现演化的。 图 4 (b) 显示，在评分标准池变化过程中，平均评分标准奖励初期迅速上升，随后出现波动，同时基于验证器的任务通过率整体提升。 值得注意的是，即使在评分标准被淘汰后且没有技能指导的情况下，行为通过率仍然保持较高水平（附录 G）。 为评估探索能力，我们在固定任务集上对比了 Arise 与无技能变体。 在所有训练阶段中，Arise 的全失败展开率始终更低，其中最显著的差异出现在早期阶段（图 4 (c)）。 结合技能注入的消融实验，这证实了技能指导对于策略发现成功轨迹具有关键作用。 附录 F 提供了单个评分标准–技能生命周期的具体示例。

paragraphs.en: Training Data Allocation and Efficiency. Behavioral evidence induces stage-dependent sampling priorities, while Arise reaches comparable task performance with fewer training steps than outcome-only RL. Figure 5 illustrates adaptive sampling probabilities for selected task types and capabilities across early, middle, and late training stages (excluding discovery sampling). Blank cells in early training reflect the initially empty pool and limited evaluation coverage, as many task-type–capability pairs remain unexplored or lack active rubrics. However, tasks associated with these blank cells are still sampled via discovery. Early sampling emphasizes execution and verification, whereas later stages prioritize debugging and efficiency as new rubrics for these capabilities enter the active pool. Coupled with rising task pass rates, this shift indicates that once the policy achieves basic execution competence, training increasingly targets error correction and workflow efficiency. At the framework level, Figure 3 (b) demonstrates Arise ’s superior sample efficiency: under the same per-step rollout budget, it achieves the step-150 pass rate of outcome-only RL by step 50 and continues improving thereafter. This represents a substantial reduction in required training steps and rollout budget (see Appendix H for training time analysis).

paragraphs.en: We introduced Arise , an agentic reinforcement learning framework that adapts the learning process to evolving capability gaps. By turning rollout evidence into evolving rubrics and paired skills, it connects the identification of behavioral weaknesses with targeted exploration and task selection. Experiments on SkillsBench and Terminal-Bench show improvements over all evaluated comparable-scale baselines, competitive performance with substantially larger models, and effective transfer across agent harnesses. The analysis further demonstrates improved training efficiency under a matched per-step rollout budget. Together, these findings highlight the value of continually adapting both behavioral feedback and learning opportunities as agent capabilities develop.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 Arise，这是一种智能体强化学习框架，能够根据不断变化的能力差距调整学习过程。 通过将展开证据转化为动态评估标准与配套技能，该框架将行为弱点的识别与目标导向的探索及任务选择联系起来。 在 SkillsBench 和 Terminal-Bench 上的实验表明，该方法在所有同规模基线模型中表现更优，性能可与规模大得多的模型相媲美，并且能有效迁移至不同的智能体工具集。 进一步的分析显示，在匹配的单步展开预算下，训练效率得到了提升。 综合来看，这些成果凸显了随着智能体能力发展，持续调整行为反馈与学习机会的重要性。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we train exclusively on Qwen3.5-27B, leaving the effectiveness of Arise across other model scales and architectures unverified. Furthermore, evaluation is limited to SkillsBench and Terminal-Bench, deferring generalization to diverse agent environments and real-world workflows to future work. Beyond these empirical limitations, rubric generation and evaluation rely heavily on the reflection and judge models. Consequently, any inherent errors or biases in these models may compromise the resulting behavioral supervision and training decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 在本研究中，我们仅使用 Qwen3.5-27B 进行训练，因此 Arise 在其他模型规模和架构上的有效性尚未得到验证。 此外，评估仅限于 SkillsBench 和 Terminal-Bench，而对多样化智能体环境及真实工作流程的泛化能力则留待未来研究。 除了这些经验性局限之外，评分标准生成与评估也高度依赖反思模型和评判模型。 因此，这些模型中任何固有的错误或偏差都可能影响最终的行为监督与训练决策。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 summarizes how Arise starts from an empty pool and uses initial rollout evidence to generate rubric–skill pairs. As rubric evaluations accumulate, capability-based sampling and selectively activated skills guide further rollouts, whose task rewards and rubric judgments support policy updates. Periodic pool updates add new rubric–skill pairs, refine skill guidance, and retire mastered criteria as training progresses.
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 总结了 Arise 如何从一个空池中出发，并利用初始的展开证据来生成评分标准-技能对。 随着评分标准评估结果的积累，基于能力的采样和选择性激活的技能会引导后续的展开过程，而这些展开的任务奖励和评分标准判断将支持策略更新。 在训练过程中，周期性的池更新会添加新的评分标准-技能对、优化技能指导，并淘汰已掌握的评估标准。

paragraphs.en: We initialize Arise with Qwen3.5-27B and train it using AReaL 2.0 ( Fu et al., 2025 ) , an asynchronous reinforcement learning framework with decoupled services for agent execution, inference, and policy optimization. DeepSeek-V4-Flash ( DeepSeek-AI et al., 2026 ) serves as both the judge model for rubric evaluation and the reflection model for rubric–skill generation and refinement, with its parameters held fixed throughout training. Training runs on 32 NVIDIA H800 GPUs for approximately two days. Table 2 summarizes the detailed training and co-evolution configurations.

paragraphs.en: For each rollout, we retain the interaction trace, including task context, agent responses, tool calls and their arguments, tool outputs, and environment feedback, together with verifier outcomes and information about available skills. Trajectory analysis and rubric evaluation use the interaction trace as their primary evidence, with final task outcomes providing auxiliary context rather than determining behavioral judgments. The resulting diagnostics identify observable behavioral gaps and useful strategies, their supporting signals, and whether existing rubrics already cover them.
paragraphs.zh: 在每次展开过程中，我们都会保留交互记录，包括任务上下文、智能体的响应、工具调用及其参数、工具输出和环境反馈，以及验证器结果和可用技能的相关信息。 轨迹分析和评分标准评估均以交互记录为主要依据，而最终的任务结果仅作为辅助背景信息，而非行为判断的决定性因素。 由此得出的诊断结果能够识别出可观察到的行为差距和有效策略、其对应的支持信号，以及现有评分标准是否已涵盖这些内容。

paragraphs.en: Pool updates aggregate evidence over the preceding ten training steps. Each generation call selects up to 256 records containing diagnostic evidence, without stratifying by task outcome. The reflection model receives these compressed diagnostics, skill-use summaries, and task and pool metadata rather than full trajectories or per-rollout task rewards and outcome labels. Issue and contrast evidence support the failure and success conditions of each new rubric, respectively. Skill refinement additionally receives the previous skill and its paired criterion and rubric, using failed-task evidence and outcome context to improve guidance when the targeted behavior remains unresolved. Prompt templates are provided in Appendix B.6 .

paragraphs.en: We construct a training corpus of 1,728 executable agent tasks spanning software engineering, cybersecurity, data processing, office workflows, manufacturing, healthcare, and scientific computing. The training corpus excludes tasks from SkillsBench and Terminal-Bench, including paraphrased variants. Each task provides an instruction, task-specific resources, a containerized execution environment, and a verifier that evaluates task completion. During reinforcement learning, the policy generates interaction trajectories online by carrying out these tasks, allowing training experience to change as the policy develops. Table 4 summarizes the distribution of training tasks across broad domains.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了一个包含 1,728 个可执行智能体任务的训练语料库，涵盖软件工程、网络安全、数据处理、办公流程、制造业、医疗保健和科学计算等领域。 该训练语料库排除了 SkillsBench 和 Terminal-Bench 中的任务，包括其改写后的变体。 每个任务都提供一条指令、任务特定的资源、一个容器化的执行环境，以及一个用于评估任务完成度的验证器。 在强化学习过程中，策略通过执行这些任务在线生成交互轨迹，从而使得训练经验能够随着策略的发展而动态变化。 表 4 总结了训练任务在各个广泛领域中的分布情况。

paragraphs.en: Task-type tags describe the operations or workflows required to complete a task, rather than its application domain or the quality of agent behavior. We use a predefined taxonomy of 82 task types, each specified by a definition and explicit inclusion and exclusion criteria.
paragraphs.zh: 任务类型标签描述的是完成一项任务所需的操作或工作流程，而非其应用领域或智能体行为的质量。 我们使用一个包含 82 种任务类型的预定义分类体系，每种任务类型都通过定义以及明确的包含和排除标准来指定。

paragraphs.en: To assign tasks to this taxonomy, we use GLM-5.2 ( GLM-5-Team et al., 2026 ) as an offline annotator, providing task instructions, names of available skills, and environment artifact paths as input. Hidden tests, reference solutions, and rollout trajectories are excluded from annotation. The annotation prompt (Appendix B.6 ) grounds each match in required operations and their observable results, rather than shared tools, file formats, or domain terminology. In particular, it distinguishes executing a workflow from merely describing that workflow in a requested document. The model first considers the full taxonomy and, only when no match is found but nearby candidates are identified, reassesses the task against those candidates.
paragraphs.zh: 为了向该分类体系分配任务，我们使用 GLM-5.2（GLM-5-Team 等，2026）作为离线标注器，输入包括任务说明、可用技能名称以及环境工件路径。 隐藏测试、参考解决方案和部署轨迹均不包含在标注范围内。 标注提示（附录 B.6）将每次匹配的依据设定为所需操作及其可观察结果，而非共享工具、文件格式或领域术语。 特别地，该提示区分了执行工作流与仅在请求的文档中描述该工作流这两种情况。 模型首先会考虑整个分类体系，只有在找不到匹配项但识别出附近候选项时，才会重新根据这些候选项评估任务。

paragraphs.en: SkillsBench evaluates agents on expertise-intensive tasks in containerized environments. The evaluation set comprises 87 tasks in the eight domains listed in Table 1 . Each task provides instructions, input data, and a task-specific environment, with an official verifier that checks the resulting answer or artifacts. Oracle solutions and hidden verifier tests are not provided to the agent. Our SkillsBench runs use Kilo Code in the curated-skills setting: the complete expert-curated skills/ directory for each task is available during execution. A skill contains a SKILL.md description and may include scripts, references, or other resources. These benchmark-provided skills are distinct from the rubric-paired skills evolved by Arise during training. The evolved skills serve as training-time guidance intended to be internalized through policy optimization; they are not provided on either evaluation benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: SkillsBench 在容器化环境中，通过高专业性任务来评估智能体。 该评估集包含表 1 中列出的八个领域内的 87 项任务。 每项任务都提供说明、输入数据和一个任务特定的环境，并配有官方验证器来检查最终的答案或成果。 智能体不会获得标准答案解决方案或隐藏验证器测试。 我们的 SkillsBench 运行在精选技能设置中使用 Kilo Code：在执行期间，每项任务的完整专家精选 skills/ 目录均可使用。 一项技能包含一个 SKILL.md 描述文件，可能还包含脚本、参考材料或其他资源。 这些由基准测试提供的技能，与 Arise 在训练过程中演化出的与评分标准配对的技能不同。 这些演化后的技能用作训练阶段的指导，旨在通过策略优化被内化；它们在任何评估基准中都不会被提供。

paragraphs.en: The context limit in our evaluations is set to the maximum length natively supported by each model. On SkillsBench, all models except GPT-5.5, whose score is taken from the official leaderboard, use thinking-enabled generation at the highest available reasoning effort, with temperature 0.6 0.6 , top- p = 0.95 p=0.95 , and top- k = 20 k=20 . paragraphs.en: To assess whether behavioral performance is maintained after rubric retirement, we track three criteria covering failure diagnosis and adaptation, complete input coverage, and explicit constraint compliance. The checkpoints at steps 100 and 150 are evaluated on this same task set with the rubric text and scoring protocol held fixed and without any Arise -generated skill guidance. paragraphs.en: To complement the rollout-budget comparison, Table 11 reports the average end-to-end time per training step for Arise and outcome-only RL. Both runs use 32 H800 GPUs with the same training parallelism and a per-step budget of 32 tasks and eight rollouts per task. The average per-step time is approximately 4.2% higher for Arise , reflecting the overall runtime difference between the two runs. Despite this modest per-step overhead, Arise reaches comparable performance in one-third as many training steps (Figure 3 (b)), implying an estimated 65% reduction in training time to reach that performance level.
paragraphs.zh: 为了补充 rollout 预算对比，表 11 报告了 Arise 和仅基于结果的强化学习在每次训练步骤中的平均端到端时间。 两次运行均使用 32 块 H800 GPU，具有相同的训练并行性，以及每次步骤 32 个任务和每个任务 8 次 rollout 的预算。 Arise 的平均每步时间高出约 4.2%，反映了两次运行之间的总体运行时间差异。 尽管存在这种轻微的单步开销，Arise 在三分之一的训练步骤中便达到了相当的性能（图 3(b)），这意味着要达到该性能水平，训练时间预计将减少 65%。
